user.title: Connect Music Assistant
user.description: Enter the integration-level Music Assistant and Home Assistant credentials. AI DJ will use the MA token to discover players by name.

station.title: Set up AI DJ station
station.description: Choose the Home Assistant playback/TTS entities and the Music Assistant player.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Music Assistant
reconfigure.description: Update the integration-level credentials. AI DJ will refresh the available player names from Music Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Music Assistant or authenticate with the supplied token.

abort.already_configured: An AI DJ station is already configured.

error.custom_personality_required: Enter custom personality instructions or choose a preset.
error.cadence_max_below_min: Maximum songs must be greater than or equal to minimum songs.
error.cadence_invalid_range: Enter valid song counts between 1 and 20.
error.audio_url_invalid: Enter one complete http:// or https:// audio URL per line.

init.title: Configure AI DJ station
init.description: Change this station's name, Home Assistant entities, briefing sources, conversation agent, or DJ personality. Music Assistant credentials are configured at the integration level.

data.name: Station name
data.custom_personality: Custom personality instructions (used only when Custom is selected)

data_description.jingle_urls: Optional direct audio URLs played before announcements. Put files in /config/www and use the matching /local URL, with one URL per line.
data_description.stinger_urls: Optional direct audio URLs played after announcements. Put files in /config/www and use the matching /local URL, with one URL per line.
